title: Cottage cheese: protein, fat and calories

seo.title: Cottage cheese nutrition: protein, fat and calories
seo.meta_description: A current 2% cottage cheese has 19 g protein and 130 calories per 150 g. See how 2% and whole-milk versions change fat while protein stays high.
seo.search_intent: Understand cottage cheese protein, fat, calories and sodium

excerpt: Cottage cheese can deliver close to 20 g protein in one small cup. Good Culture 2% provides 19 g protein, 130 calories and 3 g fat per 150 g; its 4% whole-milk single serve also provides 19 g protein but 140 calories and 6 g fat. Sodium is often the number worth checking alongside protein.
content_html:
Cottage cheese is unusual among cheeses because it stays very moist. That lets it provide a lot of protein without the calorie density of a hard aged cheese.

A 2% single-serving example

Good Culture Simply 2% lists per 150 g:

  • 130 calories
  • 19 g protein
  • 3 g fat
  • 5 g total sugars, 0 g added
  • 520 mg sodium
  • 140 mg calcium

That works out to about 12.7 g protein per 100 g.

What changes in whole-milk cottage cheese?

The same brand's 4% single serve still contains 19 g protein per 150 g, but fat rises to 6 g and calories to 140. Protein remains essentially unchanged while richness increases.

Why protein is high

Cottage cheese is made by forming milk curds and retaining them in a moist creamy dressing rather than pressing and aging them into a dry block. The curds are rich in casein protein.

Watch sodium

The 150 g examples contain about 520 mg sodium. Cottage cheese can therefore be much saltier than plain yogurt or skyr even when calories and protein look similar.

How to choose a tub

Compare protein, milkfat percentage and sodium. A lower-fat cottage cheese can save some calories while keeping protein high, but the exact numbers depend on the recipe.

faq.question: How much protein is in cottage cheese?
faq.answer: The 2% and 4% single-serve examples here both provide 19 g per 150 g.

faq.question: How many calories does cottage cheese have?
faq.answer: 130 calories per 150 g for the 2% example and 140 for the 4% whole-milk version.

faq.question: Does higher fat mean more protein?
faq.answer: Not in these products. Both provide 19 g protein; the main change is fat.

faq.question: Is cottage cheese high in sodium?
faq.answer: It can be. These single-serve examples contain about 520 mg per 150 g.
